purpose: This table is a small reference dataset mapping each airline carrier's two-character code to its full legal name, intended to feed joins from flight or booking fact tables that only carry a carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on carrier_code to enrich fact tables with the human-readable airline_name; both columns are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and the table has one row per carrier_code with no duplicates to filter.
limitations: The profile covers only 16 rows and 16 distinct carrier codes as captured at a single extraction snapshot, so any new carrier codes introduced after this snapshot will not be represented until the source is re-profiled; no data quality issues were found to exclude beyond the dropped Airbyte metadata columns.
